st.t: Talk to Mori, just north of the pub in the centre of Arceuus.
s: What can I do to help?
We should let someone know about this.

st.t: Climb the stairs in Kourend Castle and talk to Councillor Andrews on the east side of the first floor.
s: There's been a death in Arceuus.

st.t: Go to the Tower of Magic, just west of the Arceuus Library, ready to fight some level 16 Tormented Souls. Enter it, speaking to the Tower Mage outside the doors if you aren't let in.
Go up the stairs in the Tower of Magic.
Upstairs, talk to Asteros Arceuus, the son of Lord Trobin Arceuus. If he has nothing new to say, talk to Lord Trobin instead.
Go to the centre of Mount Karuulm and take the elevator down. Talk to Kaal-Ket-Jor in the dungeon below.
Leave the dungeon. Inspect the ancient grave south-east of Mount Karuulm, just west of the Battlefront and south of the water source. A Battlefront teleport takes you right there.
Follow the tracks west from the grave, inspecting each thing in turn: a bush to the north-west, a plant further west, another plant further west, a tree stump further west, then a plant to the south.
Inspect the final plant and kill the Trapped Soul (level 30) which appears.
Inspect the rocks around the Dark Altar, north of Arceuus, until you find a device. Fairy ring CIS or a games necklace to Wintertodt gets you close.
Talk to Lord Trobin Arceuus to finish the quest.
